course_description: This course introduced the Linux and Open-Source industry and knowledge of the most popular Open-Source applications. The course aims to cover major components of the Linux operating system and explain the technical proficiency to work on the Linux command line. The course has a basic understanding of security and administration related topics server management, working on the command line and permissions.

course_learning_outcomes.text: Apply various types of users on a Linux system, its security and process.
Develop students’ skills and knowledge in operating system implementation, table structure and device input output system
Apply storage management, file, directories and solve storage management problem
Developing student critical thinking through the creation of a design paper for a proposed server solution
Apply the skills in implementing different kinds of OS especially Linux, and its concept and properties.
Develop students’ skills and knowledge in operating system implementation, table structure and the input output system and devices.
Apply storage management, file, directories and solve storage management problem

topic_learning_outcomes.text: Discuss the problem of address binding, concept of segmentation and fragmentation.
Explain what is paging, its implementation
Discuss different kinds of table structure and paging interact with segmentation.
Described benefits of virtual memory system.
